Sobre a vaga

Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Mainframe Network System Programmer, who wants to learn and transform his career.

Key Responsibilities

Installation & Maintenance

  • Install, configure, and upgrade mainframe networking (TCP/IP, VTAM, EE, NetView).
  • Apply maintenance via SMP/E and customize networking parameters and exits.

System Programming & Support

  • Provide technical support for networking subsystems.
  • Troubleshoot SNA/VTAM issues, TCP/IP connectivity, performance problems.
  • Support integration with CICS, IMS, DB2, MQ.
  • Manage traces, dumps, logs, and IPL-related network requirements.

Performance & Capacity

  • Monitor and tune TCP/IP stacks, VTAM, and EE connections.
  • Optimize routing, buffers, and bandwidth.
  • Plan capacity and future network growth.

Security & Compliance

  • Maintain network security (RACF/ACF2/TSS).
  • Configure AT‑TLS, IPSec, firewalls, and encrypted connections.
  • Ensure compliance with SOX, PCI-DSS, and internal policies.

Disaster Recovery

  • Develop and test networking DR plans.
  • Ensure connectivity during DR exercises and support HA/failover strategies.

Change & Release Management

  • Support migrations, new features, and deployments.
  • Document configurations and follow ITIL processes.

Collaboration & Support

  • Work with system, storage, security, and distributed network teams.
  • Provide 24x7 on-call support.
  • Assist developers with mainframe connectivity.

Required Skills

  • Strong experience with z/OS networking (TCP/IP, VTAM, SNA).
  • Knowledge of EE, HiperSockets, NetView.
  • Proficiency in IP/routing, DNS, FTP, TN3270, encryption protocols.
  • SMP/E experience; strong troubleshooting/tuning ability.
  • Familiarity with JCL, REXX, automation tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years as a Mainframe Network System Programmer.
  • Experience with Sysplex networking, multi-stack, high availability.
  • Knowledge of distributed system integration over TCP/IP.
  • Familiarity with OMEGAMON for IP / NetView.
  • ITIL awareness; audit/compliance experience (SOX, PCI-DSS, ISO27001).

Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) is the technology partner of choice for industry leading organizations worldwide. Since its inception in 1968, TCS has upheld the highest standards of innovation, engineering excellence, and customer service. It has set an aspiration to become the world's largest AI-led technology services company and is enabling its clients to transform themselves across the full AI stack, from infrastructure to intelligence. Rooted in the heritage of the Tata Group, TCS is focused on creating long term value for its clients, its investors, its employees, and the community at large. With a highly skilled workforce spread across 55 countries and 202 service delivery centers across the world, the company has been recognized as a top employer in six continents. With the ability to rapidly apply and scale new technologies, the company has built long term partnerships with its clients – helping them emerge as perpetually adaptive enterprises. Many of these relationships have endured into decades and navigated every technology cycle, from mainframes in the 1970s to artificial intelligence today. TCS sponsors 14 of the world’s most prestigious marathons and endurance events, including the TCS New York City Marathon, TCS London Marathon and TCS Sydney Marathon with a focus on promoting health, sustainability, and community empowerment. Caution against fraudulent job offers: TCS doesn’t charge any fee throughout the recruitment process. Refer here: https://www.tcs.com/careers/india/recruitment-fraud-alert
